reviews.snippet:
Overall, we had a great experience at the hospital, and I would like to sincerely thank the entire team for taking such good care of us during this important time.

A special mention to the housekeeping team (Gayatri, Amudha, Shakunthala, Jhansi, and Kavita) for keeping the room clean and ensuring my wife was comfortable throughout our stay. We truly appreciate their care and support.

I would also like to thank all the nurses who tirelessly assisted us and helped us care for our newborn baby. Their patience, kindness, and dedication made a huge difference during what was a very emotional and important time for our family.

The doctors were highly professional as well, especially Dr. Poornima, who was approachable, patiently answered all our questions and doubts, and handled the delivery process seamlessly. We are very grateful for her professionalism and care.

Unfortunately, our only disappointment was with the lady in charge of managing the rooms and visitor arrangements. We felt that we were treated unfairly during the delivery of our baby. She did not allow my mother-in-law and sister-in-law to wait outside the delivery room to welcome the baby, stating that only one person was permitted. While we understand that hospitals need to have rules and restrictions, we noticed another patient’s family of four waiting outside the same delivery area, and no similar restriction appeared to be enforced in their case.

When we questioned this, her response came across as quite rude and dismissive. As we are from Northeast India, the experience unfortunately left us feeling that we may have been treated differently because of our background. I sincerely hope this was not the case, but the way the situation was handled certainly gave us that impression.

This was particularly disappointing during such a special and emotional moment for our family, and unfortunately, it is the reason I am giving the hospital 4 stars instead of 5.

Despite this incident, we are grateful to the doctors, nurses, housekeeping staff, and the rest of the team who took excellent care of my wife and our baby!

reviews.snippet:
From the moment we walked into Apollo Cradle until the day we took our babies home, we felt less like patients and more like family.

The warmth and hospitality shown by everyone - the doctors , the nurses, maintenance staff, housekeeping team, front desk, and managers—made what could have been an overwhelming experience feel incredibly comfortable and reassuring. Every member of the team was kind, patient, and always ready to help with a smile.

The round-the-clock care provided to my wife and our newborn babies was truly exceptional. Whether it was answering our questions, helping us with the babies, or simply checking in to make sure we were comfortable, the support never stopped. As first-time parents, this meant more to us than words can express.

We had chosen the Suite Room and were pleasantly surprised with a beautifully arranged candlelight dinner. It was such a thoughtful gesture that gave us a special moment to celebrate becoming parents amidst all the excitement and emotions.

A heartfelt thank you to Dr. Mekhala Dwarkanath, whose confidence, compassion, and expertise guided us throughout our pregnancy journey, and to Dr. Nagarathna DS, who stood by us during the delivery and postpartum period, constantly reassuring us and giving us the confidence we needed. We always felt we were in the safest hands.

A special mention to Manjula, our Delivery Manager, and Anitha, whose kindness, attentiveness, and constant support made our stay even more comfortable. They went above and beyond to ensure every concern was addressed promptly and that both my wife and our babies received the best possible care. Their warmth and dedication truly made us feel at home.

Apollo Cradle has built something truly special—not just a hospital with excellent medical care, but a place where families are welcomed with warmth, empathy, and genuine care. We will always cherish the memories of welcoming our little angels here.

Thank you to everyone at Apollo Cradle for making one of the most important milestones of our lives so beautiful and unforgettable. We will always be grateful.

reviews.snippet:
This is going to be always latest feedback.

One of the worst decision I have taken selecting this hospital for my wife. What should have been one of the most important and emotional moments of my life turned into a very stressful and mentally disturbing experience because of the behaviour of certain staff members and the lack of basic patient care standards.

During the initial preparation before surgery, she observed staff handling procedures without proper gloves, which was extremely concerning from a hygiene and patient safety perspective.

Additionally, some staff members were speaking very disrespectfully in Kannada, assuming that she could not understand the language. Comments such as “today is Sunday, still so much work, why do they come and die here” were made in reference to patients. Hearing such insensitive remarks while being prepared for surgery caused me significant emotional distress.

Further, while I was in the ICU, she was provided with a pillow that had visible blood stains and appeared uncleaned.  I asked the brother to change it .This was completely unacceptable in a hospital environment where hygiene and infection control should be maintained at the highest standards.

I would also like to highlight that since my procedure was scheduled on a Sunday, I was charged an additional amount for the delivery. However, despite paying extra charges, the level of care and service provided was extremely disappointing. It raises a serious concern as to what the additional charges were for, when patients were subjected to such poor treatment and inadequate staffing.
After surgery, I had to wait for more than one hour to be shifted to the ward because housekeeping staff were unavailable, and I was informed that there was less staff due to it being a Sunday. This delay, especially after a major surgery, added further discomfort and stress during an already vulnerable time.
Overall, my pregnancy and delivery experience at the hospital was deeply disappointing. Instead of feeling cared for and supported, I felt mentally tortured, neglected, and emotionally disturbed during a time when compassion, dignity, and professionalism were expected.

We have done urine culture it shows I have severe urine infection. I am showing at other hospital and doc is zero happy about infection I have acquired in the hospital
We haven’t paid less to take all these and
Bill was more than 2 lakh
We’re we would have got better service from other hospital. Now the pain has increased to  severe level and the urine infection is not going down as almost a month.
